rationale: Policyholder's vehicle was totaled in a rear-end collision, with injuries to the policyholder from the accident – this is unambiguously an auto claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am by another driver traveling ~35 mph who failed to brake. Vehicle is a total loss with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Police report on file with other driver's insurance information.

case_facts.description: rear-ended at red light by another driver going 35 mph who did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled - entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: yes - includes other driver's insurance information
